modeFinding.trigger: Play accepts unequal-rate next preparation while AutoMix is off; before held next open finishes, enable natural or dj and request the same next item.
modeFinding.failure: The pending job captured autoMixEnabled=false. Same-item pending deduplication reused it after enabling AutoMix, so it rejected unequal-rate eligibility and never became ready. The two-second bounded readiness wait exposed format_mismatch; increasing the budget would not resolve this contract bug.
modeFinding.fix: On an actual mode change only, setAutoMixMode captures the existing pending next item, invalidates/cancels its revision while under the existing pipeline mutex, commits the new mode, then calls the existing source-token and revision-guarded rearm outside that mutex. Published preload is not reopened. No new intent owner or render-thread synchronization is introduced. A concurrent queue clear/replacement or source generation change wins through the existing guards.
modeFinding.staticReview: The setter and the underlying preload transaction are identical between the final source slice and merge. Cancellation/join stays outside pipeline mutex; the pending token is still owned by the established shared stream/job mechanism. Mode validation, existing published-stream precise-seek behavior, stale selection/identity checks and timeline exactness remain present.
modeFinding.deterministicRegression: testAutoMixModeChangeRearmsPendingPreloadWithLatestEligibility holds an unequal-rate next open, covers off-to-natural and off-to-dj, requires a second entry/open, then requires ready and the same next identity. It is included in the six-case preload-only entry and full runtime list.
modeFinding.executionAttribution: Implementation owner supplied RED then GREEN and final CTest logs. This supplemental reviewer read those artifacts but did not rerun or rebuild the final mode executable.
